|| table_alias || chr(10) || 'where 1=1' || chr(10) || ';' else ',' end as sel_clause from w_columns order by column_id;

TEMPLATE.CODE: to_char(|, '999G999G999G999D99', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.''''')

TEMPLATE.name: uc
TEMPLATE.CODE: -- Resolve user code(s) and show all other codes of same code type -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- with w_code_selection as (select '|' as code_list from dual), w_code_sel_clean as (select replace(code_list,' ','') as code_list from w_code_selection), w_user_codes as (select * from bsi_uc c inner join w_code_sel_clean s on instr(',' || s.code_list || ',', ',' || cast(c.uc_uid as varchar2(4000)) || ',') > 0 order by instr(',' || s.code_list || ',', ',' || cast(c.uc_uid as varchar2(4000)) || ',')), w_user_codes_sorted as (select c.*, rownum as row_num from w_user_codes c ) select uc.code_type_nr, uc.uc_uid, case when ss.row_num is null then null else ' ' || ss.row_num end as sel_index, bsiutl_uctext(uc.uc_uid,246) uc_name, case when uc.value_uid = 0 then to_char(uc.value_decimal) else concat(concat(uc.value_uid, ' - '), bsiutl_uctext(uc.value_uid,246)) end as value, case when uc.parent_uid = 0 then null else concat(concat(uc.parent_uid, ' - '), bsiutl_uctext(uc.parent_uid,246)) end as parent, uc.sortcode, uc.shortcut, uc.ext_key, uc.text, uc.uc_uid || ', /* ' || bsiutl_uctext(uc.uc_uid,246) || ' */' as in_clause from bsi_uc uc inner join bsi_code_type ct on ct.code_type_nr = uc.code_type_nr left join w_user_codes_sorted ss on ss.uc_uid = uc.uc_uid where uc.code_type_nr in (select code_type_nr from w_user_codes) order by to_number(sel_index)

TEMPLATE.name: ind
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Show all indices for a given table
TEMPLATE.CODE: -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Show all indices for a given table -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- select distinct ix.table_owner, ix.table_name, ix.owner, ix.index_name, ix.uniqueness, ix.num_rows, ix.distinct_keys, ix.status, ix.visibility, listagg(ic.column_name, ' / ') within group (order by ic.column_position) over (partition by ic.index_owner, ic.index_name) as listagg from sys.all_indexes ix inner join sys.all_ind_columns ic on ic.index_owner = ix.owner and ic.index_name = ix.index_name where lower(ix.table_name) like '%|%' order by ix.table_owner, ix.table_name, ix.index_name ;

TEMPLATE.name: ver
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Show BSI CRM migration versions on this database
TEMPLATE.CODE: select * from bsi_migration order by migration_nr desc ;

TEMPLATE.name: log
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Write a log entry with timestamp to dbms_output
TEMPLATE.CODE: dbms_output.put_line(concat(to_char(sysdate,'yyyy.mm.dd hh24:mi:ss - '), '|'));

TEMPLATE.name: ts
te
TEMPLATE.CODE: call bsiutl_endTransaction('|');

TEMPLATE.name: trf
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Translation of TRF_DATA_MANIPULATION code in stage 2 tables of DWH Import
TEMPLATE.CODE: concat(concat(trf_data_manipulation, ' - '), case trf_data_manipulation when 0 then 'NOP (ERROR)' when 1 then 'INSERT' when 2 then 'UPDATE' when 3 then 'DELETE' when 4 then 'NOP' when 5 then 'INSERT BULK' when 6 then 'UPDATE BULK' else '## UNKNOWN ##' end) as trf_data_manipulation,

TEMPLATE.name: flush
TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: Flush SQL Shared Pool for performance analysis
TEMPLATE.CODE: execute sys.flush_pool;
